note: Idle lines for the palengke NPCs (click them outside a quest step): one random line per click, never the same twice in a row, short enough for two rows of the box. Quest lines come from palengke-story.md. Names: the cook is Aling Conching (Mac, 20 Oct 2026). The lines are in English here (repo change, 21 Oct 2026: the art folder's are Tagalog; no Tagalog in the game, Mac).

aling-conching.name: Aling Conching
aling-conching.title: cooks every night, just in case
lines: Have you eaten? There's still lugaw.
Forty years I've been here. I'm not leaving.
Don't mind the onions. They're only crying.
This market used to be full by four in the morning.
The Scale used to watch over us. Now we watch it.
Bring me fresh onions and we'll have sinigang.
Pido? He's at the gate, counting nothing.
They'll come back. I can feel it.

mang-pido.name: Mang Pido
mang-pido.title: night guard, 35 years
lines: Thirty-five years a guard here. Nothing left to guard, but I'm still the guard.
Careful in Tarp Row. The umbrellas bite.
If you hear footsteps in the Fish Market, that's not a person.
We weren't allowed to sleep on duty. Now who'd report me?
My flashlight still has battery. I hope.
The Scale wakes every two hours. A guard, like me.
Conching's cooking again. Who for, I don't know.
Gate's clear. Mostly.

tisay.name: Tisay
tisay.title: looking for her mother's ledger
lines: I'm not doing anything wrong. I'm just looking.
That's Mama's handwriting in the ledger. I need it.
Keep quiet. They won't notice us.
Don't tell Mang Pido I'm here.
The Fish Market's still wet. Ever since the storm.
I'm not scared. Just tired.
I've got a light. That's enough.

kuya-jun.name: Kuya Jun
kuya-jun.title: the butcher's son
lines: I'm looking for my father's cleaver. It was his lucky one.
He stood right here, every day, for thirty years.
I don't need help. ...But thanks.
The Sangkalan isn't just hungry. It's angry.
He left a letter. I haven't read all of it yet.
It's quiet here at Butcher Row. Too quiet.
Bring me iron and I can fix it.

mang-berto.name: Mang Berto
mang-berto.title: the market's last grocer
lines: Potions, whetstones, lanterns. Fresh as I can get them.
Going in deep? Buy two of everything.
The Slums store charges the same. I checked.
A Return Lantern home is cheaper than walking back hurt.
My cart has survived three floods and one Scale.
Conching feeds you, I keep you standing.
No agimats here. Those you earn out there.
Pido says I talk to the vegetables. They listen.
